masks.far_spot_note: 2026-10-12: every P3 mask below was drawn on the close-spot ref_final and is invalid for the far view, so P3 is null like the other stops (old specs: capture/tests/capture_lock_v1_close_2026-10-05.json). pose_check and qc_session then register with ecc.ecc_translation_robust on the full frame minus a 24 px border (mask_source 'auto_residual'); qc_session's saturation share uses the full frame ('full_frame_fallback') and its ref_vs_golden info check is skipped.
masks.format: capture/ecc.py regions_mask(): base all|none, then include regions set to 1, then exclude regions set to 0; rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x1/y1 exclusive; polygon = vertices filled by ecc.fill_polygon (even-odd scanline rule, identical on the Pi and the GB10). Coordinates are native 2304x1296 pixels of the frame at that position (rotation 0).

static_background.purpose: pixels that never change between captures at that stop: shelf frame, boards, side panels, empty back walls, the textured room wall on the right. Used by pose_check (P3 vs golden) and qc_session (ref vs query).
static_background.missing_position_rule: null = not drawn yet (to be drawn on the catalog-sweep references). Consumers then use ecc.ecc_translation_robust on the full frame minus a 24 px border and report mask_source='auto_residual'.

mug_region.purpose: the study-mug compartment opening plus the mug shelf's front face; qc_session's saturation share is computed here (minus the glare box).
mug_region.missing_position_rule: null = consumers use the full frame and report region_source='full_frame_fallback'.

glare.purpose: known specular highlight; excluded from the static mask and from the mug_region saturation share, reported separately.

sha256_P3.note: ecc.mask_sha256 of the rasterised 1296x2304 mask (uint8 0/1, C order); consumers recompute and refuse on mismatch. null while the P3 masks are null (consumers read the hash only for a non-null mask).

registration.mode_note: edges (gradient magnitude) is chosen for robustness to shadows / spatially varying light: on real shelf frames (ref_final vs lp1.10/locked_00, P3 static mask) a synthetic soft shadow moved the intensity estimate 0.126 px (cc 0.948) and the edges estimate 0.007 px (cc 0.996). It is NOT more robust to global tone changes: with gamma 0.6 x 1.3 + clipping, intensity moved 0.092 px (cc 0.977) and edges 0.138 px (cc 0.957). Untouched same-lock frames: intensity and edges agree within 0.03 px; edges cc is lower (0.998 vs 0.9999). No real L1-vs-L2 or real-shadow pair exists yet; re-check on the first sitting's L1/L2 calibration stills. Evidence: capture/MODULE1.md section 5, data/raw/2026-10-05_shelf-final/masks/check_tone_modes_{gb10,pi}.txt.
registration.levels_note: 4 since lock_version 2 (was 3): with the P3 masks null (auto_residual, full frame), synthetic 30-60 px shifts + 2 deg roll of the far golden-scene frame did not converge in the euclidean fit at 3 levels (cc 0.27 -> error) and converged at 4 (rot -2.000, cc 0.9995); pure shifts up to 120 px converged at both; real far pairs gave the same estimates at 3 and 4 (data/raw/2026-10-12_pilot-prep/capture-config/probe_pose_levels{3,4}_mincc0.6.txt).

pose_check.min_cc_note: below this the registration is reported as unreliable (exit 12, verdict error; advisory since run_arrangement 1.3.0, recorded only). 0.60 since lock_version 2 (was 0.80, set on the close-spot static mask): on the full frame (auto_residual) real far pairs across days / scene changes / LensPosition registered at translation cc 0.764-0.797 (2026-10-10 far_p3 vs post-bump frames and vs 2026-10-12 now.jpg), which 0.80 turned into 'error'; a pure 1 deg roll gives translation cc 0.68. The wrong-viewpoint negative (old close-spot frame) still fails to converge -> error. Evidence: data/raw/2026-10-12_pilot-prep/capture-config/probe_pose_levels3.txt (min_cc 0.80) vs probe_pose_levels4_mincc0.6.txt.
pose_check.status: ADVISORY since 2026-10-13 (run_arrangement 1.3.0, DECISIONS 2026-10-13: 'roughly the same spot' is enough): flag/refuse/error are printed and recorded in sitting.json, nothing stops a sitting; registration is done per view through the tags (capture/tags.py 0.2.0: >= 2 tags, refuse only RMS > 10 px or leave-one-out > 30 px). Pre-1.3.0 behaviour (accepted 2026-10-12, D17; relaxed 2026-10-12 per DECISIONS 2026-10-12: the robot is not stationary; register + crop instead of a hard pose gate). Flag ~10 px / 1 deg, refuse only gross (80 px / 5 deg). The 2026-10-10 camera bump moved the far view +18.6..+19.2 px, +3.1..+4.4 px, -0.39..-0.42 deg (data/raw/2026-10-10_far-camera/register_far.txt): the old 10 px / 2 deg gate refused it although the shelf stayed well inside the frame; under these values it is a flag (pre-1.3.0: logged, the sitting continued with a note; now recorded only). 80 px is about the golden's smallest frame margin around the tag rectangle (tag corners x 673-1850, y 82-1141: margins top 82, bottom 155, right 454, left 673 px; check_golden.txt), so a larger upward shift can push the top tags out of the frame.
